scope: Read-only aggregated source quality preservation and final R3 runtime skin/clearance audit for the forest tree mix, stamina and kneeling release.

animationReview.sourceScope: Death-only existing Death_Ground_Contact target on the right front hip/thigh/shin/upper foot; source rig/weights/UV/indices/clips unchanged. No new target slot.
animationReview.limits: Actual Babylon CPU skin and exact offline mesh checks, not GPU/FPS or native rendered lighting verification. Float32 re-extraction amplifies geometric normals on very small triangles; measured custom-vs-geometric deviation error remains below1e-4.

limitations: No browser automation, actual game screenshot, mobile/S23 GPU/FPS or physical device memory measurement.
Image headers and unchanged content-addressed graphs prove source dimensions/preservation; they do not prove all high textures are resident simultaneously.
Texture budgets are existing policy limits, not measured total GPU memory.
Expected tree-species/height changes are allowed; protected forest/town/cave source layouts and their sampled terrains remain unchanged.
